posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
So I just finished the Episode.

SO MUCH STUFF TODAY!

This was the most information packed episode of the Letters Page yet. So much new story was talked about and revealed and I couldn't be happier. Really glad I got my questions in at the last second because those turned out to be fairly interesting!

I think one of the big things that stood out to me, besides the obviously awesome stuff about the Master, was the maaaaaasive Tactics reveal! The dark shadowy figure we see in current Tactics art is certainly none other than Gloomweaver in the form of our dearly dead Dr. Medico. Awesome.

Honestly, best episode yet by far.
